title: QA evidence anchor (data only)
description: Data that names an external anchor for the digest of bundle-manifest.json. This file is not covered by the manifest and does not prove anything by itself; it never contains or implies an attestation.

anchor_reference.description: where the anchor value was published (a URL, a run id, a subject name); informative, never fetched

digest.description: sha256 of the exact bytes, lower-case hex, prefixed

schema_version.description: MAJOR.MINOR; an unsupported MAJOR is refused before anything else is read

extensions.description: informational additions only; tolerated and listed, never used for a decision
